purpose: Illustrative transport scenes; not company-owned facilities or fleet evidence

assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: photographic hero background for Fengji International, a Chinese enterprise logistics website serving China–Central Asia rail and multimodal cargo.
Primary request: Create a premium, expansive, photorealistic landscape photograph of a container freight train crossing the open Central Asian steppe with a distant mountain range. This must feel like commissioned transport photography for a serious corporate website, not a dramatic fantasy or an AI technology illustration.
Scene/backdrop: vast natural steppe, a believable rail corridor, low distant Tian Shan-like mountains, pale blue dawn atmosphere and gentle warm early sunlight. One long freight train with restrained dark blue and neutral shipping containers.
Composition/framing: very wide panoramic landscape, approximately 21:9. Elevated oblique viewpoint, realistic parallel rails and connected wagons, the train curves gently from the lower right into the middle distance. Keep the left 40 percent relatively calm with open landscape and atmospheric depth to support white website text added later in code; train and strongest visual detail occupy the right and lower half. Horizon in upper third. This is a real full-bleed image asset, no website UI.
Lighting/mood: quiet confidence, clear air, expansive scale, convincing natural light and subtle imperfections, balanced highlights, readable landscape. Rich navy and steel blue, muted natural green and sand tones, restrained warm sunlight; no heavy teal-orange grading.
Constraints: physically plausible train, rail geometry and container dimensions. No logos, company names, readable lettering, banners, flags, location labels, people close-ups, text, watermark, UI controls, maps or graphic route lines. Do not imply a specific owned company facility. No warehouse interior, no collage, no fantastical infrastructure, no oversaturated sunset.

Asset type: service photography for a formal China–Central Asia logistics corporate website.

Wide 3:2 landscape composition, truck in the right-middle of the frame, winding paved road leading towards distant layered mountains, natural dry steppe surroundings, realistic vehicle and road geometry, subtle tire and metal texture, clean morning daylight, confident and expansive rather than advertising spectacle. Camera is at a low roadside three-quarter angle, enough space around the whole vehicle, crisp but naturally graded. Harmonious steel-blue, stone and muted gold palette, matching premium railway transport photography. No readable text, logos, flags, people close-ups, watermark, UI, collaged modes of transport or fantastical infrastructure. Generic illustrative operation, not a claim of a specific company's owned vehicle.
